Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Gabrieli Wood-Framed Upholstered Swivel Chair, 29.9"W, Charcoal
Colors: Charcoal
Materials: Wood
This wood-framed swivel chair is upholstered in a usefully neutral charcoal gray, which makes it easy to work into your existing decor. As a place to work, converse, or relax, this chair is a stylish multitasker. 29.9"W x 33.1"D x 31.9"H Wood frame and foam-filled cushions This swivel chair has an elegant wood base upholstered with a stain-resistant fabric. No assembly required Avoid moisture, and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty
